papers.summary: Generalises f-divergence-based randomized smoothing to Wasserstein and total-variation frameworks that handle smoothing measures with bounded support, such as uniform distributions; proves negative certified robustness results for lq perturbations, validated on CIFAR-10 with ResNet.

papers.title: Certified Neural Network Watermarks with Randomized Smoothing
papers.summary: Certifiable watermarking of neural networks using randomized smoothing over model parameters, guaranteeing the watermark cannot be removed unless parameters change by more than an l2 threshold; also more empirically robust than earlier watermarking methods.

papers.title: Certified Robustness Against Natural Language Attacks by Causal Intervention
papers.summary: CISS certifies NLP models against word substitution attacks by learning causal effects through smoothing in latent semantic space; on YELP its certified robustness beats the runner-up by 6.7%, with 79.4% empirical robustness under syntactic attacks.

papers.title: Certifying Out-of-Domain Generalization for Blackbox Functions
papers.summary: Certifies distributional robustness of black-box models with bounded losses using the Hellinger distance, scaling to ImageNet and non-smooth losses; gives the first non-vacuous certified out-of-domain generalization on ImageNet and beats prior methods on smaller tasks.

papers.title: Double Sampling Randomized Smoothing
papers.summary: Double Sampling Randomized Smoothing (DSRS) tightens l2 certificates using probabilities from an additional smoothing distribution, provably certifying radius of order sqrt(d) under mild assumptions; certifies larger radii than baselines on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and ImageNet.

papers.title: GSmooth: Certified Robustness against Semantic Transformations via Generalized Randomized Smoothing
papers.summary: GSmooth generalises randomized smoothing to certify robustness against general semantic transformations, including ones without closed forms such as defocus blur and pixelate, using dimension augmentation and a surrogate image-to-image network to approximate transformations.

papers.title: Improved Certified Defenses against Data Poisoning with (Deterministic) Finite Aggregation
papers.summary: Finite Aggregation certifies robustness against data poisoning by training base classifiers on overlapping unions of small disjoint subsets, improving on DPA; certified fractions rise by up to 3.05%, 3.87% and 4.77% on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and GTSRB.

papers.title: Input-agnostic Certified Group Fairness via Gaussian Parameter Smoothing
papers.summary: FairSmooth certifies group fairness of classifiers independent of input distribution using Gaussian parameter smoothing and averaged per-group smooth classifiers; nonlinear functional analysis shows the resulting manifold has an input-independent global Lipschitz constant.

papers.title: Intriguing Properties of Input-Dependent Randomized Smoothing
papers.summary: Shows input-dependent randomized smoothing methods lack formal guarantees and suffer from the curse of dimensionality, then gives a framework and concrete variance design that permits certified input-dependent smoothing under strict restrictions, tested on CIFAR10 and MNIST.

papers.title: Linearity Grafting: Relaxed Neuron Pruning Helps Certifiable Robustness
papers.summary: Linearity grafting linearises insignificant ReLU neurons and optimises their slopes and intercepts to tighten certified bounds, improving certifiable robustness by over 30% on CIFAR-10 without certified training and scaling complete verification to 17M-parameter models.

papers.title: RetrievalGuard: Provably Robust 1-Nearest Neighbor Image Retrieval
papers.summary: RetrievalGuard is a provably robust 1-nearest-neighbour image retrieval method that smooths the retrieval model to a bounded Lipschitz constant, keeping Recall@1 invariant to l2 adversarial perturbations within a computable radius.

papers.title: Robustness Verification for Contrastive Learning
papers.summary: RVCL is a robustness verification framework for contrastive learning encoders that avoids dependence on attacks, labels and downstream tasks, using extreme value theory to relate encoder robust radius to downstream radius; evaluates robustness of both models and images.

papers.title: TPC: Transformation-Specific Smoothing for Point Cloud Models
papers.summary: TPC certifies point cloud models against semantic transformations such as rotation, shearing and tapering with transformation-specific smoothing, covering additive, composable and indirectly composable categories; certified accuracy against z-axis twisting within 20 degrees rises from 20.3% to 83.8%.

months.label: April 2022
months.intro: CAV 2022, IJCAI 2022 and ISSTA 2022 decisions: CAV papers target verifier efficiency through synthesised linear approximations and shared certificates, and verified safe reinforcement learning through Trainify and RINO reachability. IJCAI brought individual fairness guarantees and neuro-symbolic verification, while ISSTA defined epsilon-weakened robustness; backdoor verification also appears.

papers.title: ε-weakened robustness of deep neural networks
papers.summary: Defines epsilon-weakened robustness, bounding the proportion of adversarial examples in a region, proves its decision problem PP-complete and gives statistical decision and maximum-radius algorithms with user-controlled error, polynomial in network dimension and size.

papers.title: Certified Robustness via Randomized Smoothing over Multiplicative Parameters of Input Transformations
papers.summary: Randomized smoothing over multiplicative parameters of input transformations certifies classifiers against gamma correction perturbations; an asymmetric Rayleigh distribution gives better certificates than Gaussian, Laplace or uniform smoothing for some perturbation values.

papers.title: Individual Fairness Guarantees for Neural Networks
papers.summary: Certifies epsilon-delta individual fairness of feed-forward neural networks under learnt metrics such as Mahalanobis distance, globally bounding nonlinearities with piecewise-linear functions encoded as MILP; a modified loss yields networks orders of magnitude fairer than prior methods.

papers.title: Neuro-Symbolic Verification of Deep Neural Networks
papers.summary: Neuro-symbolic verification lets neural networks serve as part of logical specifications, extending verification to complex real-world properties such as stopping before a stop sign, and can be implemented on top of existing neural network verification infrastructure.

papers.title: Example Guided Synthesis of Linear Approximations for Neural Network Verification
papers.summary: Automatically synthesises sound linear approximations of activation functions for neural network verification by learning from generated examples, then bounding violations with global optimisation to restore soundness; solves more verification problems than hand-crafted approximations.

papers.title: Neural Network Robustness as a Verification Property: A Principled Case Study
papers.summary: Sets out general principles for empirically analysing neural network robustness as a mathematical property across training, verification and deployment, comparing the many existing robustness notions, and applies them in a case study showing practical benefits.

papers.title: RINO: Robust INner and Outer Approximated Reachability of Neural Networks Controlled Systems
papers.summary: RINO computes inner and outer approximations of reachable sets for discrete- and continuous-time systems controlled by neural networks, combining zonotopes with mean-value AE extensions and Taylor methods; it is at least an order of magnitude faster than Verisig 2.0 and ReachNN*.

papers.title: Shared Certificates for Neural Network Verification
papers.summary: Shared certificates reduce neural network verification cost by reusing intermediate-layer abstractions that overlap or contain each other across different inputs and perturbations, without precision loss; evaluated on image classifiers under patch and geometric perturbations.

papers.title: Trainify: A CEGAR-Driven Training and Verification Framework for Safe Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Trainify trains deep reinforcement learning systems on coarse abstract state spaces and refines them from counterexamples in a CEGAR loop until all properties verify; on six control systems it yields provably safe policies without sacrificing reward or robustness.

papers.title: Verifying Neural Networks Against Backdoor Attacks
papers.summary: Verifies that a neural network is free of backdoors at a given success rate by combining statistical sampling with abstract interpretation, either proving absence of a backdoor or generating trigger inputs, avoiding the accuracy loss of randomized smoothing.

months.label: March 2022
months.intro: CVPR 2022 decisions: certified patch defenses built on vision transformers within smoothing-based certification, and 3DeformRS, which specialises randomized smoothing to spatial deformations of point clouds.

papers.title: 3DeformRS: Certifying Spatial Deformations on Point Clouds
papers.summary: 3DeformRS certifies point cloud DNNs against parameterised spatial deformations such as rotation and twisting by specialising randomized smoothing to vector-field deformations; for PointNet under 3-degree z-rotation it gives a 3x larger certificate 20x faster than prior work.

papers.title: Certified Patch Robustness via Smoothed Vision Transformers
papers.summary: Uses vision transformers within smoothing-based certified patch defenses, exploiting their ability to handle heavily masked images to obtain better certified patch robustness, faster inference and no substantial drop in standard accuracy.

papers.title: Towards Practical Certifiable Patch Defense with Vision Transformer
papers.summary: Certifies image classifiers against patch attacks by placing a Vision Transformer inside Derandomized Smoothing, trained with progressive smoothed image modeling and using isolated band unit self-attention; on ImageNet it reaches 41.70% certified accuracy under 2% patches, against 26.00% before.

months.label: January 2022
months.intro: ICLR 2022, ICRA 2022 and USENIX Security 2022 decisions: randomized smoothing leads, with variance-reduced ensembles, top-k guarantees, conformal prediction and policy smoothing. Certified training covers IBP convergence, deep equilibrium models and Lipschitz networks, and reinforcement learning certification appears in COPA and CROP. REASSURE brings sound and complete repair, ROMAX targets multiagent RL, and PatchCleanser defends against adversarial patches.

papers.title: PatchCleanser: Certifiably Robust Defense against Adversarial Patches for Any Image Classifier
papers.summary: PatchCleanser certifies any image classifier against adversarial patches through two rounds of pixel masking; on ImageNet it reaches 83.9% top-1 clean accuracy and 62.1% certified robust accuracy against a 2%-pixel square patch.

papers.title: Adversarially Robust Conformal Prediction
papers.summary: Extends conformal prediction to adversarial inputs by smoothing the non-conformity score with Gaussian noise to bound its Lipschitz constant, giving prediction sets with finite-sample coverage under any l2-bounded attack; validated on CIFAR10, CIFAR100 and ImageNet.

papers.title: Almost Tight L0-norm Certified Robustness of Top-k Predictions against Adversarial Perturbations
papers.summary: Derives an almost tight l0-norm certified robustness guarantee for top-k predictions using randomized smoothing; on ImageNet the smoothed classifier reaches 69.2% certified top-3 accuracy when an attacker may change 5 pixels.

papers.title: Boosting Randomized Smoothing with Variance Reduced Classifiers
papers.summary: Uses ensembles as base models for randomized smoothing, since their lower variance under noise enlarges certified radii, and cuts sample complexity up to 55-fold; ensembles of 3 to 10 models reach average certified radius 0.86 on CIFAR10 and 1.11 on ImageNet.

papers.title: Boosting the Certified Robustness of L-infinity Distance Nets
papers.summary: Shows l-infinity-distance nets have an inherent certified robustness advantage and improves their training with a loss mixing scaled cross-entropy and clipped hinge loss, raising certified accuracy on CIFAR-10 at eps 8/255 from 33.30% to 40.06%.

papers.title: COPA: Certifying Robust Policies for Offline Reinforcement Learning against Poisoning Attacks
papers.summary: COPA certifies offline reinforcement learning policies against training-time poisoning, bounding how many manipulated trajectories are tolerated under per-state action stability and cumulative reward criteria, with new partition and aggregation protocols; some certificates are proved tight, others NP-complete.

papers.title: CROP: Certifying Robust Policies for Reinforcement Learning through Functional Smoothing
papers.summary: CROP certifies reinforcement learning policies at action and reward levels, using local smoothing of Q-function policies for per-state action robustness and global plus adaptive local smoothing for lower bounds on finite-horizon cumulative reward, evaluated on Atari, Highway and CartPole.

papers.title: Certified Robustness for Deep Equilibrium Models via Interval Bound Propagation
papers.summary: IBP-MonDEQ is a deep equilibrium layer whose robustness is verified by interval bounds obtained as the unique fixed point of an IBP-inspired equilibrium equation; such models reach l-infinity certified robustness comparable to similar-sized explicit networks.

papers.title: Complete Verification via Multi-Neuron Relaxation Guided Branch-and-Bound
How to Robustify Black-Box ML Models? A Zeroth-Order Optimization Perspective
papers.summary: ZO-AE-DS defends black-box models using only queries by combining denoised smoothing with zeroth-order optimization and a prepended autoencoder to reduce gradient-estimate variance, improving accuracy, certified robustness and query complexity on image classification and reconstruction.

papers.title: Improved deterministic l2 robustness on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100
papers.summary: Certifies 1-Lipschitz CNNs under l2 by relaxing orthogonalization of the last linear layer, adding a Householder activation and certificate regularization; provable robust accuracy rises 4.71% on CIFAR-100 and 5.81% on CIFAR-10.

papers.title: On the Certified Robustness for Ensemble Models and Beyond
papers.summary: Analyses certified robustness of ensembles, proving diversified gradients and large confidence margins are necessary and sufficient under model smoothness, and proposes Diversity Regularized Training, which yields higher certified L2 robustness than single and ensemble models on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and ImageNet.

papers.title: On the Convergence of Certified Robust Training with Interval Bound Propagation
papers.summary: Analyses convergence of Interval Bound Propagation certified training, proving that for an overparameterized two-layer ReLU network with logistic loss, gradient descent converges linearly to zero robust training error with high probability given small perturbation radius and large width.

papers.title: Policy Smoothing for Provably Robust Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Policy smoothing adds Gaussian noise to observations so the total reward of a reinforcement learning agent is certified against adaptive adversaries, based on an adaptive Neyman-Pearson lemma; tested on Cartpole, Pong, Freeway and Mountain Car.

papers.title: Provably Robust Adversarial Examples
Sound and Complete Neural Network Repair with Minimality and Locality Guarantees
papers.summary: REASSURE repairs ReLU networks by adding a patch network on the linear region of a buggy input, giving sound and complete repair that is minimal in function space and leaves outputs away from the repair region unchanged.

papers.title: Formal Verification of Stochastic Systems with ReLU Neural Network Controllers
papers.summary: Verifies safety of stochastic linear systems with Gaussian noise and ReLU network controllers by abstracting them as a graph, bounding transition probabilities with Satisfiability Modulo Convex formulas, and computing which initial states stay safe with given confidence over a horizon.

papers.title: ROMAX: Certifiably Robust Deep Multiagent Reinforcement Learning via Convex Relaxation
papers.summary: ROMAX trains multiagent reinforcement learning policies robust to worst-case updates of other agents, solving the inner minimisation of a minimax objective with convex relaxation of neural networks, which also gives a certified bound; it beats prior methods on mixed cooperative-competitive tasks.

months.label: December 2021
months.intro: ICSE 2022 decisions: DeepPAC analyses local robustness of DNNs in a black-box way, learning an affine model of local behaviour with a PAC guarantee.

papers.title: Towards Practical Robustness Analysis for DNNs based on PAC-Model Learning
papers.summary: DeepPAC analyses local robustness of DNNs in a black-box way, learning an affine model of local behaviour via scenario optimisation with a PAC guarantee; across 20 models on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and ImageNet it beats the statistical method PROVERO.

months.label: November 2021
months.intro: AAAI 2022 decisions: neural-network control systems lead, with neural supermartingales for stability, RNN controller synthesis, GoTube statistical reachability, and Taylor models combined with zonotopes. Probabilistic certification work includes CC-CERT, DeformRS and input-specific sampling for randomized smoothing, alongside SDP verification tightened with linear cuts.

papers.title: CC-CERT: A Probabilistic Approach to Certify General Robustness of Neural Networks
papers.summary: CC-CERT gives probabilistic robustness certificates for neural networks under general attacks, including semantic transformations such as rotation and translation, by estimating failure probability under a sampled attack distribution with Chernoff-Cramer bounds.

papers.title: DeformRS: Certifying Input Deformations with Randomized Smoothing
papers.summary: DeformRS-VF and DeformRS-Par certify networks against vector-field and parameterized input deformations, such as rotations, translations, scaling and affine maps, via randomized smoothing; DeformRS-Par reaches 39% certified accuracy for rotations within 10 degrees on ImageNet.

papers.title: Distillation of RL Policies with Formal Guarantees via Variational Abstraction of Markov Decision Processes
papers.summary: Distills deep RL policies into discrete latent Markov decision process models learned by a variational autoencoder, with bisimulation bounds and PAC guarantees that let formal MDP methods check reachability, safety-constrained reachability and discounted-reward objectives.

papers.title: GoTube: Scalable Statistical Verification of Continuous-Depth Models
papers.summary: GoTube statistically verifies continuous-depth neural models by solving global optimization problems over time to build a reachable tube that is conservative up to chosen probability and tightness, avoiding the wrapping effect and outscaling existing reachability tools.

papers.title: Input-Specific Robustness Certification for Randomized Smoothing
papers.summary: Input-Specific Sampling speeds up randomized smoothing certification by adapting the sample size to each input while bounding the radius loss; it certifies over three times faster on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet at a cost of 0.05 certified radius.

papers.title: Recurrent Neural Network Controllers Synthesis with Stability Guarantees for Partially Observed Systems
papers.summary: Synthesizes recurrent neural network controllers for partially observed nonlinear uncertain systems with stability guarantees, using convex conditions from integral quadratic constraints and the S-lemma enforced by a projected policy gradient method that needs fewer samples.

papers.title: Stability Verification in Stochastic Control Systems via Neural Network Supermartingales
papers.summary: Verifies almost-sure asymptotic stability of nonlinear stochastic control systems with neural network policies by learning neural ranking supermartingales, which also give the first bounds on stabilization time; tested on stochastic reinforcement learning environments.

papers.title: Tight Neural Network Verification via Semidefinite Relaxations and Linear Reformulations
papers.summary: Tightens SDP-based neural network verification by adding linear cuts from the reformulation-linearisation technique to a layerwise SDP relaxation; on MNIST networks of about 10k nodes the share of certified cases rises from 0% to 82%.

papers.title: Towards Automating Model Explanations with Certified Robustness Guarantees
papers.summary: A concept-based interpretation method that automatically produces prototype-based concept explanations without human intervention and gives certified robustness guarantees that these explanations hold under adversarial perturbations, tested on real-world datasets.

papers.title: Verification of Neural-Network Control Systems by Integrating Taylor Models and Zonotopes
papers.summary: Verifies closed-loop neural-network control systems by chaining Taylor-model reachability for the dynamics with zonotope analysis for the network without losing dependency information; the tool is the first to analyse all benchmarks of an annual NNCS reachability competition.

months.label: September 2021
months.intro: NeurIPS 2021 and POPL 2022 decisions: certified training and bound propagation lead, with Beta-CROWN, fast IBP training and local Lipschitz bounds. POPL contributed PRIMA multi-neuron abstractions, DeepJ for Clarke Jacobians and interval universal approximation. Other directions include center smoothing for structured outputs, SmoothMix, convex relaxations for simplex inputs and safety of Bayesian neural network policies.

papers.title: Beta-CROWN: Efficient Bound Propagation with Per-neuron Split Constraints for Neural Network Robustness Verification
Center Smoothing: Certified Robustness for Networks with Structured Outputs
papers.summary: Center smoothing extends randomized smoothing to structured outputs such as sets, images and text, certifying that the output change, measured by a distance metric, stays small under any norm-bounded input perturbation, without much loss in base model performance.

papers.title: Fast Certified Robust Training with Short Warmup
papers.summary: Speeds up IBP certified training with a new weight initialization, full batch normalization and regularization against exploded bounds and ReLU imbalance, reaching 65.03% verified error on CIFAR-10 and 82.36% on TinyImageNet in 160 and 80 epochs.

papers.title: Infinite Time Horizon Safety of Bayesian Neural Networks
papers.summary: Verifies infinite-horizon safety of Bayesian neural network policies by training a separate deterministic certificate network, computing a safe weight set and rejecting posterior samples outside it; also extended to safe exploration in reinforcement learning.

papers.title: Make Sure You're Unsure: A Framework for Verifying Probabilistic Specifications
Overcoming the Convex Barrier for Simplex Inputs
papers.summary: Designs a tight convex relaxation for verifying robustness to perturbations within the probability simplex that stays linear in neuron count, improving l1 verified accuracy on CIFAR-10 and MNIST by up to 14.4% and verifying a multi-modal text-image classifier.

papers.title: Partition-Based Formulations for Mixed-Integer Optimization of Trained ReLU Neural Networks
papers.summary: Partition-based mixed-integer formulations of trained ReLU networks group node inputs and take convex hulls over partitions via disjunctive programming, trading size against tightness; the smaller relaxations outperform existing formulations in experiments.

papers.title: Relaxing Local Robustness
papers.summary: Introduces relaxed top-k robustness and affinity robustness, properties that allow some label sets to be close, and builds models that can be efficiently certified for them, giving lower rejection rates and higher certified accuracies than standard local robustness.

papers.title: ScaleCert: Scalable Certified Defense against Adversarial Patches with Sparse Superficial Layers
papers.summary: ScaleCert certifies defenses against adversarial patches on high-resolution images by using superficial important neurons for network compression, cutting adversarial region search and prediction noise; certified accuracy on ImageNet rises from 36.3% to 60.4%.

papers.title: Semialgebraic Representation of Monotone Deep Equilibrium Models and Applications to Certification
papers.summary: Gives a semialgebraic representation of ReLU monotone deep equilibrium models so semidefinite programming can certify robustness under general Lq norms, estimate Lipschitz constants and propagate ellipsoidal uncertainty, outperforming existing monDEQ certification.

papers.title: SmoothMix: Training Confidence-calibrated Smoothed Classifiers for Certified Robustness
papers.summary: SmoothMix trains smoothed classifiers on self-mixup combinations of samples along adversarial directions, calibrating confidence of over-confident near off-class samples, and markedly improves certified l2 robustness of randomized smoothing over existing robust training methods.

papers.title: Towards Better Understanding of Training Certifiably Robust Models against Adversarial Examples
papers.summary: Identifies smoothness of the loss landscape, besides bound tightness, as a key factor in certifiable training with linear relaxations, and designs a training method with both properties that performs well across a wide range of perturbation sizes.

papers.title: Training Certifiably Robust Neural Networks with Efficient Local Lipschitz Bounds
papers.summary: Trains certifiably robust networks with a tighter, trainable local Lipschitz bound that removes rows and columns for activations constant near each input, plus clipped activations with learnable thresholds; it improves clean and certified accuracy on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and TinyImageNet.

papers.title: A dual number abstraction for static analysis of Clarke Jacobians
papers.summary: DeepJ soundly bounds the Clarke Jacobian of Lipschitz, possibly non-differentiable functions with an abstract domain over dual numbers and forward-mode dual interval evaluation, analysing Lipschitz robustness of networks under rotation, contrast, haze and composed perturbations.

papers.title: Interval universal approximation for neural networks
papers.summary: Proves an interval universal approximation theorem for networks with squashable activations, so provably robust l-infinity networks exist, but shows the needed range approximation problem is Delta-2-intermediate, so building such networks efficiently is inherently hard.

papers.title: PRIMA: general and precise neural network certification via scalable convex hull approximations
papers.summary: PRIMA verifies neural networks with any non-linear activation using multi-neuron convex abstractions from polynomial convex hull approximation algorithms; it verifies up to 20%, 30% and 34% more images on ReLU, Sigmoid and Tanh networks.

months.label: July 2021
months.intro: ASE 2021, CCS 2021 and ICCV 2021 decisions: semantic transformations are a common theme, with TSS and 3DCertify for point clouds, alongside Cert-RNN for recurrent networks, DetectorGuard for object detectors and integer-only certification for quantized neural networks. ASE added DFV, which uses distribution models for falsification and verification.

papers.title: Distribution Models for Falsification and Verification of DNNs
papers.summary: DFV learns an input distribution model, prefixes it to the DNN and restates the property over its input space so existing falsifiers and verifiers target realistic inputs; a study with 7 tools and 93 models shows more representative counterexamples.

papers.title: Cert-RNN: Towards Certifying the Robustness of Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.summary: Cert-RNN certifies robustness of recurrent networks such as vanilla RNNs and LSTMs with precise abstract transformers for their nonlinear operations, giving bounds on average 1.86 times larger than POPQORN on an MNIST sequence model.

papers.title: DetectorGuard: Provably Securing Object Detectors against Localized Patch Hiding Attacks
papers.summary: DetectorGuard provably secures object detectors against localized patch hiding attacks by checking objectness from a robust image classifier against detector boxes, so a certified object is detected or an alert is raised, at under 1% clean cost.

papers.title: Learning Security Classifiers with Verified Global Robustness Properties
papers.summary: Trains security classifiers, structured as ensembles of logic rules, to satisfy verified global robustness properties via a booster-fixer scheme using counterexample guided inductive synthesis; a Twitter spam classifier meets five properties with a 5.4% drop in true positive rate.

papers.title: TSS: Transformation-Specific Smoothing for Robustness Certification
papers.summary: TSS certifies robustness against semantic transformations, using transformation-specific randomized smoothing for resolvable ones like blur and stratified sampling for interpolating ones like rotation; it reaches 30.4% certified accuracy against rotations within 30 degrees on ImageNet.

papers.title: Integer-arithmetic-only Certified Robustness for Quantized Neural Networks
papers.summary: An integer randomized smoothing method with quantization gives smoothed classifiers that use only integer arithmetic, with a tight l2 robustness guarantee, matching accuracy and running 4 to 5 times faster than floating-point certified methods on CPUs and mobile devices.

papers.title: Robustness Certification for Point Cloud Models
papers.summary: 3DCertify verifies robustness of 3D point cloud models to semantic transformations using first-order Taylor relaxations for any differentiable transformation and a precise max-pool relaxation; it certifies 95.7% of point clouds against rotations of 60 degrees.

months.label: May 2021
months.intro: ICML 2021 and RSS 2021 decisions: Lipschitz-based certified training leads, with Skew Orthogonal Convolutions, globally-robust networks and l-infinity-dist neurons. Smoothing work covers certified segmentation, deterministic L1 smoothing and CRFL for federated learning, alongside formal explanations for monotonic classifiers and Lyapunov-stable neural-network control.

papers.title: CRFL: Certifiably Robust Federated Learning against Backdoor Attacks
papers.summary: CRFL trains federated learning models with certified robustness against backdoors by clipping and smoothing model parameters, giving sample-wise certificates tied to poisoning ratio, attacker count and training iterations, and the first benchmark for this setting.

papers.title: Explanations for Monotonic Classifiers
papers.summary: Gives algorithms polynomial in classifier run time and feature count to compute one formal explanation of a black-box monotonic classifier, plus a practical model-agnostic algorithm for enumerating formal explanations.

papers.title: Globally-Robust Neural Networks
papers.summary: Builds globally-robust networks by integrating efficient global Lipschitz bounds into training, producing models certifiable by construction with low time and memory cost; a large Tiny-Imagenet model trains in hours, and local bounds are proved not to raise maximum verifiable accuracy.

papers.title: Improved, Deterministic Smoothing for L1 Certified Robustness
Provable Lipschitz Certification for Generative Models
papers.summary: Upper bounds the Lipschitz constant of generative models by approximating the set of vector-Jacobian products with layerwise zonotope abstractions, giving tight bounds on small networks and scaling to VAE and DCGAN architectures.

papers.title: Scalable Certified Segmentation via Randomized Smoothing
papers.summary: Certifies image and point cloud segmentation with randomized smoothing, using multiple-testing correction and allowing abstention on single pixels or points; achieves competitive accuracy with guarantees on Pascal Context, Cityscapes and ShapeNet.

papers.title: Skew Orthogonal Convolutions
papers.summary: Skew Orthogonal Convolution builds orthogonal, gradient-norm-preserving convolution layers from the exponential of a skew-symmetric Jacobian with a bounded Taylor approximation, training provably Lipschitz CNNs faster with better standard and certified accuracy on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100.

papers.title: Towards Certifying L-infinity Robustness using Neural Networks with L-inf-dist Neurons
papers.summary: Introduces l-infinity-dist neurons whose networks are 1-Lipschitz under the l-infinity norm, giving certified robustness from output margins; reaches 93.09% certified accuracy on MNIST, 35.42% on CIFAR-10 and 16.31% on TinyImageNet.

papers.title: Lyapunov-stable neural-network control
papers.summary: Synthesizes a Lyapunov-stable neural-network controller together with a neural Lyapunov function, verifying the Lyapunov condition as a mixed-integer linear program that either certifies it or returns counterexamples; also inner-approximates the region of attraction, tested on pendulum and quadrotor robots.

months.label: April 2021
months.intro: CAV 2021 and IJCAI 2021 decisions: complete verification and tooling lead, with DNNV, PEREGRiNN, DeepSplit and dependency-based branching. Verification extends to recurrent networks with Prover, binarized networks with BDD4BNN and programs invoking neural networks, while Verisig 2.0 and barrier certificates address controllers. NNrepair and robust explanations for NLP models round out the month.

papers.title: An Iterative Scheme of Safe Reinforcement Learning for Nonlinear Systems via Barrier Certificate Generation
papers.summary: SRLBC synthesizes safe DNN controllers for nonlinear systems by alternating deep RL training with a verifier that computes a maximal safe initial region and barrier certificate via polynomial abstraction and bilinear matrix inequalities, handling systems up to dimension 12.

papers.title: Automated Safety Verification of Programs Invoking Neural Networks
papers.summary: Verifies system-level safety of programs that call neural networks by tightly integrating program analysis and network analysis in an abstract interpretation framework, evaluated on 26 variants of a restricted autonomous-driving benchmark.

papers.title: BDD4BNN: A BDD-Based Quantitative Analysis Framework for Binarized Neural Networks
papers.summary: BDD4BNN encodes binarized neural networks into Binary Decision Diagrams through cardinality constraints over blocks, enabling precise quantitative robustness analysis and interpretability of BNNs, with a prototype tool showing effectiveness and efficiency.

papers.title: DNNV: A Framework for Deep Neural Network Verification
papers.summary: DNNV standardizes input and output formats for DNN verifiers, offers a DSL for properties, and applies simplification and reduction operations so more verifiers can run existing benchmarks, raising benchmark support from 30% to 74%.

papers.title: NNrepair: Constraint-Based Repair of Neural Network Classifiers
papers.summary: NNrepair repairs neural network classifiers by fault localization followed by constraint solving to modify parameters at an intermediate or last layer; on MNIST and CIFAR-10 it improves accuracy by 45.56 points on poisoned and 10.40 on adversarial data.

papers.title: PEREGRiNN: Penalized-Relaxation Greedy Neural Network Verifier
papers.summary: PEREGRiNN verifies polytopic input-output specifications of ReLU networks using a convex solver both as feasibility checker and to penalize relaxation, pushing large relaxations toward the input; it verifies more properties faster on an MNIST robustness suite.

papers.title: Robustness Verification of Semantic Segmentation Neural Networks Using Relaxed Reachability
papers.summary: Verifies robustness of semantic segmentation networks in NNV via a relaxed reachability method that solves only a chosen share of LPs and supports up-sampling layers, measuring robust pixel percentage and robust IoU on M2NIST with reduced verification time.

papers.title: Scalable Polyhedral Verification of Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.summary: Prover, a verifier for recurrent neural networks, computes polyhedral abstractions of nonlinear recurrent updates via sampling, optimization and Fermat's theorem, refining them by gradient descent; it certifies RNNs for vision, speech (with abstractions of the preprocessing pipeline) and motion-sensor classification beyond prior tools.

papers.title: Verisig 2.0: Verification of Neural Network Controllers Using Taylor Model Preconditioning
papers.summary: Verisig 2.0 checks closed-loop systems with tanh/sigmoid neural network controllers using Taylor-model reachability with preconditioning and shrink wrapping, parallelized for larger networks; on 10 benchmarks it is more accurate and faster than three tools, with speed-ups up to 21x and 268x.

papers.title: DEEPSPLIT: An Efficient Splitting Method for Neural Network Verification via Indirect Effect Analysis
papers.summary: DeepSplit is a complete verifier for ReLU networks based on symbolic interval propagation that picks split nodes by their indirect effect on successor relaxations and encodes splits efficiently in linear programming, giving 1 to 2 orders of magnitude speedups.

papers.title: Efficient Neural Network Verification via Layer-based Semidefinite Relaxations and Linear Cuts
papers.summary: Verifies local robustness of neural networks with a layer-based semidefinite relaxation combined with linear cuts and chordal graph decompositions, provably tighter than prior approaches and an order of magnitude faster than earlier SDP methods.

papers.title: On Guaranteed Optimal Robust Explanations for NLP Models
papers.summary: Computes optimal robust explanations for NLP neural networks as word subsets that guarantee unchanged prediction under bounded embedding perturbations of the other words, using implicit hitting sets and maximum universal subsets, evaluated on SST, Twitter and IMDB.

papers.title: Probabilistic Sufficient Explanations
papers.summary: Defines probabilistic sufficient explanations, the simplest feature subsets that give strong probabilistic guarantees the classifier behaves the same under the data distribution, found with probabilistic circuits and expected predictions; compared favourably with Anchors and logical explanations.

papers.title: Towards Scalable Complete Verification of Relu Neural Networks via Dependency-based Branching
papers.summary: Complete verification of ReLU networks that branches on ReLU states according to dependencies between nodes, giving MILP sub-problems with fewer integer constraints; on the fully connected networks of the first verification competition it reports 145% gains over prior complete methods.

papers.title: Verifying Reinforcement Learning up to Infinity
papers.summary: Verifies time-unbounded safety of neural network controllers for dynamical systems with abstract interpretation that builds template polyhedra via MILP and interval arithmetic, yielding safe invariant overapproximations of the reach set for linear, piecewise linear and nonlinear dynamics.

months.label: February 2021
months.intro: CVPR 2021, ICRA 2021 and PLDI 2021 decisions: PLDI brought DeepT for certifying transformers, provable repair of DNNs and GenProve with generative models. CVPR work centres on certified training, including linear bound propagation and covariance propagation, plus PointGuard for point clouds, while ICRA covered reachability of closed-loop systems including Reachable Polyhedral Marching.

papers.title: Fast and precise certification of transformers
papers.summary: DeepT certifies Transformer networks via abstract interpretation with a Multi-norm Zonotope domain covering ℓ1 and ℓ2 perturbations, including transformers for softmax and dot product; it certifies radii 28x larger than prior work and handles synonym attacks on long word sequences.

papers.title: Provable repair of deep neural networks
papers.summary: Repairs a DNN so it provably satisfies a specification: Provable Point Repair finds minimal repairs for finite point sets with any activation, and Provable Polytope Repair handles convex polytopes for piecewise-linear networks, both reduced to linear programming via a Decoupled DNN architecture.

papers.title: Robustness certification with generative models
papers.summary: GenProve certifies classifiers against semantic image transformations produced by generative models, such as changing age or hair colour, by capturing infinite non-convex sets of activations and distributions over them, giving sound deterministic and probabilistic guarantees on realistic networks.

papers.title: Achieving Robustness in Classification Using Optimal Transport With Hinge Regularization
papers.summary: Learns 1-Lipschitz binary and multi-class classifiers with a hinge-regularized Kantorovich-Rubinstein loss grounded in optimal transport, which yields a certifiable robustness bound; experiments show the guarantees hold without significant accuracy loss, and adversarial examples become visually meaningful.

papers.title: PointGuard: Provably Robust 3D Point Cloud Classification
papers.summary: PointGuard certifies 3D point cloud classifiers against adversarially modified, added or deleted points by majority voting over random point subsamples; the derived bound on the number of tolerated points is proven tight, with evaluation on ModelNet40 and ScanNet.

papers.title: Simpler Certified Radius Maximization by Propagating Covariances
papers.summary: Maximizes the certified radius of smoothed classifiers by propagating the covariance of the Gaussian smoothing distribution through the network instead of Monte Carlo sampling, giving runtime savings on moderately deep networks for CIFAR-10, ImageNet and Places365 at a small accuracy cost.

papers.title: Towards Evaluating and Training Verifiably Robust Neural Networks
papers.summary: Proves CROWN is always tighter than interval bound propagation with suitable bounding lines, proposes linear bound propagation (LBP) to verify large networks with lower verified error, and a ParamRamp activation that improves verified robustness on MNIST, CIFAR-10 and Tiny-ImageNet.

papers.title: Efficient Reachability Analysis of Closed-Loop Systems with Neural Network Controllers
papers.summary: Computes forward reachable sets of closed-loop systems with neural network controllers through a linear programming formulation with input set partitioning and support for measurement and process noise; it gives 10x less conservatism in half the computation time of prior methods, shown on a quadrotor.

papers.title: Reachable Polyhedral Marching (RPM): A Safety Verification Algorithm for Robotic Systems with Deep Neural Network Components
papers.summary: Reachable Polyhedral Marching computes exact forward and backward reachable sets of ReLU networks over multiple steps by incrementally enumerating polyhedral input cells, with early exit on unsafe cells; on ACAS Xu it finds unsafe actions many times faster than the fastest existing method.

months.label: January 2021
months.intro: ICLR 2021 and USENIX Security 2021 decisions: certified training leads, with Cayley-transform orthogonal layers, compositional architectures and detection-aware IBP. Complete verification speeds up with GPU-based LiRPA branch-and-bound and geometric projections, while a floating-point attack shows how to fool a complete verifier. Patch defenses such as BagCert and PatchGuard, and collective certificates for graph neural networks, also appear.

papers.title: Certify or Predict: Boosting Certified Robustness with Compositional Architectures
papers.summary: Boosts certified robustness without retraining by pairing an accurate deep network with a smaller certified network and adaptively selecting which one processes each input; on CIFAR-10 at ℓ∞ 2/255 it reaches 90.1% natural accuracy with 27.5% certified robustness.

papers.title: Collective Robustness Certificates: Exploiting Interdependence in Graph Neural Networks
papers.summary: Collective robustness certificates for Graph Neural Networks count how many predictions stay stable under a single shared perturbation, fusing single-node certificates using locality; on Citeseer node classification the average number of certifiable feature perturbations rises from 7 to 351.

papers.title: Deep Partition Aggregation: Provable Defenses against General Poisoning Attacks
Efficient Certified Defenses Against Patch Attacks on Image Classifiers
papers.summary: BagCert combines a model architecture with a certification procedure for adversarial patches, plus a loss for end-to-end training of certified patch robustness; on CIFAR10 it certifies 10,000 examples in 43 seconds on one GPU, with 86% clean and 60% certified accuracy against 5x5 patches.

papers.title: Enforcing robust control guarantees within neural network policies
papers.summary: Builds neural-network control policies that enforce the same provable robustness criteria as robust control by embedding convex-optimization-based projection layers, improving average-case performance over robust control and worst-case stability over non-robust deep RL on several domains.

papers.title: Estimating Lipschitz constants of monotone deep equilibrium models
papers.summary: Bounds the Lipschitz constants of monotone deep equilibrium models as a simple function of the strong monotonicity parameter, for both input-output and weight-output maps; the bounds are small relative to standard DNNs and yield depth-independent PAC-Bayes generalization bounds.

papers.title: Fantastic Four: Differentiable and Efficient Bounds on Singular Values of Convolution Layers
papers.summary: Derives four provable, differentiable upper bounds on the spectral norm of 2D multi-channel convolution layers and takes their minimum as an efficient bound usable to bound Lipschitz constants or curvature; as a regularizer it improves generalization and robustness on MNIST and CIFAR-10.

papers.title: Fast Geometric Projections for Local Robustness Certification
papers.summary: Checks ℓ2 local robustness of piecewise-linear feed-forward networks by searching for decision boundaries in nearby linear regions using simple geometric projections, implemented in parallel on GPU; it is more precise than many approximate verifiers and orders of magnitude faster than complete ones.

papers.title: Fast and Complete: Enabling Complete Neural Network Verification with Rapid and Massively Parallel Incomplete Verifiers
papers.summary: Replaces linear programming in branch-and-bound complete verification with backward-mode LiRPA on GPUs, adding gradient-based bound tightening, batch splits and minimal LP use to keep completeness; on a single GPU it runs an order of magnitude faster than LP-based approaches.

papers.title: Fooling a Complete Neural Network Verifier
papers.summary: Shows floating-point roundoff can be exploited to build adversarial networks whose true robustness differs sharply from what a complete verifier reports, and to plant backdoors the verifier misses; a small weight perturbation is offered as a simple defense against this attack.

papers.title: Orthogonalizing Convolutional Layers with the Cayley Transform
papers.summary: Parameterizes orthogonal convolutional layers by applying the Cayley transform to skew-symmetric convolutions in the Fourier domain; networks with these layers outperform prior deterministic certified defenses against ℓ2-bounded adversaries while scaling to larger architectures.

papers.title: Provably robust classification of adversarial examples with detection
papers.summary: Jointly trains a provably robust classifier and detector by adding an abstain/detection class and extending interval bound propagation to this objective under ℓ∞ perturbations; it outperforms plain IBP on MNIST and CIFAR-10, especially for large perturbations such as 8/255 and 16/255.

papers.title: Scaling Symbolic Methods using Gradients for Neural Model Explanation
papers.summary: Scales SMT-based analysis to large networks for model explanation by using Integrated Gradients to select first-layer neurons, then solving for minimal input masks that keep those activations above a threshold; resulting saliency maps on MNIST, ImageNet and Beer Reviews are sparser with higher saliency scores.

papers.title: Scaling the Convex Barrier with Active Sets
papers.summary: A dual algorithm operating on a small active set of dual variables makes a tighter, exponentially sized linear relaxation of piecewise-linear activations practical, with GPU parallelism and anytime valid bounds; it gives better bounds than off-the-shelf solvers in a fraction of their time.

papers.title: PatchGuard: A Provably Robust Defense against Adversarial Patches via Small Receptive Fields and Masking
papers.summary: PatchGuard provably defends image classifiers against localized adversarial patches by using CNNs with small receptive fields to bound corrupted features and a robust masking aggregation, with strong provable and clean accuracy on ImageNet, ImageNette and CIFAR-10.

months.label: December 2020
months.intro: AAAI 2021 and ICSE 2021 decisions: certified training leads, with class-similarity-based verifiable training, SingleProp and Toeplitz-based Lipschitz regularization of convolutional layers. Other directions include certifying spatial robustness, SMT-based verification of quantized neural networks, reachability of Neural ODEs with stochastic guarantees and PROVERO's quantitative verification, plus certified defenses against data poisoning and malicious federated-learning clients.

papers.title: Adaptive Verifiable Training Using Pairwise Class Similarity
papers.summary: Improves verifiable training by clustering similar classes and assigning robustness criteria by inter-cluster similarity, via an Inter-Group Robustness Prioritization loss or a neural decision tree of sub-classifiers; clean performance improves up to 9.63% on Fashion-MNIST and 30.89% on CIFAR10.

papers.title: Adversarial Training and Provable Robustness: A Tale of Two Objectives
Efficient Certification of Spatial Robustness
papers.summary: Certifies robustness of vision models against vector field (spatial) transformations for the first time via model-agnostic convex relaxations that can be plugged into many neural network verifiers; experiments across architectures and datasets show effectiveness and scalability.

papers.title: Fast Training of Provably Robust Neural Networks by SingleProp
papers.summary: SingleProp is a regularizer for training provably robust networks that needs only one extra forward propagation, making it cheaper than certified defenses that run certification during training; on MNIST and CIFAR-10 it trains faster with comparable certified accuracy.

papers.title: Intrinsic Certified Robustness of Bagging against Data Poisoning Attacks
On Lipschitz Regularization of Convolutional Layers using Toeplitz Matrix Theory
papers.summary: Uses Toeplitz matrix theory to derive an upper bound on the Lipschitz constant of convolutional layers that is both tight and cheap to compute, and builds on it an algorithm for training Lipschitz-regularized convolutional neural networks.

papers.title: On the Verification of Neural ODEs with Stochastic Guarantees
papers.summary: Verifies Neural ODEs with Stochastic Lagrangian Reachability, which builds a tight Reachtube using global optimization and gives confidence intervals on its bounds, avoiding the wrapping effect; a forward-mode adjoint sensitivity method speeds up gradients, and convergence rates are established.

papers.title: Provably Secure Federated Learning against Malicious Clients
papers.summary: Makes federated learning provably secure against malicious clients by training multiple global models on random client subsets and taking a majority vote, with a tight bound on tolerated malicious clients; it reaches 88% certified accuracy on MNIST with 20 of 1,000 clients malicious.

papers.title: Scalable Verification of Quantized Neural Networks
papers.summary: Shows that bit-exact verification of quantized neural networks with bit-vector specifications is PSPACE-hard, and proposes three techniques to scale SMT-based verification of such networks, giving speed-ups of up to three orders of magnitude over existing approaches.

papers.title: Tightening Robustness Verification of Convolutional Neural Networks with Fine-Grained Linear Approximation
papers.summary: DeepCert tightens robustness verification of convolutional networks with sigmoid-like activations through finer-grained linear approximations; on LeNet and MNIST/CIFAR models it improves the certified lower bound by up to 286.28% and runs up to 1566.76 times faster than other verifiers.

papers.title: Scalable Quantitative Verification For Deep Neural Networks
papers.summary: PROVERO, a quantitative verification framework for deep neural networks, runs tests until a probabilistic property is proven with formal guarantees, for deterministic or randomized DNNs; applied to adversarial robustness, it certifies large DNNs where existing verifiers are inconclusive, needing only black-box access.

months.label: September 2020
months.intro: NeurIPS 2020 decisions: randomized smoothing is prominent, from denoised smoothing for pretrained classifiers to patch, confidence and higher-order certificates. Bound propagation advances with auto_LiRPA, tightened single-neuron relaxations and memory-efficient SDP, alongside exact local Lipschitz computation. Certified monotonicity, including COMET, graph convolution networks, binarized neural networks with EEV and Revel's verified reinforcement-learning exploration broaden the scope.

papers.title: (De)Randomized Smoothing for Certifiable Defense against Patch Attacks
papers.summary: Certifies image classifiers against adversarial patches with a de-randomized smoothing scheme that yields deterministic certificates and trains faster than interval-bound methods; for 5x5 patches on CIFAR-10 it reaches about 57.6% certified accuracy versus at most 30.3% before, and scales to ImageNet.

papers.title: An efficient nonconvex reformulation of stagewise convex optimization problems
papers.summary: Reformulates stagewise convex problems, including neural network verification, as nonconvex problems with simple bound constraints solved by a modified projected gradient method that reaches the global optimum; it yields small duality gaps quickly and outpaces off-the-shelf and specialized verification solvers.

papers.title: Automatic Perturbation Analysis for Scalable Certified Robustness and Beyond
papers.summary: Generalizes LiRPA bounds such as CROWN to arbitrary computational graphs in an automatic, differentiable framework with loss fusion, enabling certified defense on DenseNet, ResNeXt and Transformer and, for the first time, on Tiny ImageNet and Downscaled ImageNet; released as the auto_LiRPA library.

papers.title: Black-Box Certification with Randomized Smoothing: A Functional Optimization Based Framework
papers.summary: Casts randomized smoothing certification as functional optimization, allowing non-Gaussian smoothing distributions and attacks beyond ℓ2, including ℓ1 and ℓ∞; the framework exposes an accuracy-robustness trade-off, and its new distributions certify better than previous works.

papers.title: Certifiably Adversarially Robust Detection of Out-of-Distribution Data
papers.summary: Certifies worst-case out-of-distribution detection by using interval bound propagation to upper-bound classifier confidence over an ℓ∞-ball around OOD points and minimizing that bound in training; the guarantees generalize beyond the training OOD data with little accuracy loss.

papers.title: Certified Defense to Image Transformations via Randomized Smoothing
Certified Monotonic Neural Networks
papers.summary: Certifies monotonicity of general piecewise-linear neural networks with respect to chosen features by solving a mixed integer linear program, enabling training with increasing monotonicity regularization until certified; it is more accurate and efficient than methods like Deep Lattice Networks.

papers.title: Certified Robustness of Graph Convolution Networks for Graph Classification under Topological Attacks
papers.summary: Gives the first robustness certificate for graph convolution networks in graph classification under topological perturbations with local and global budgets, using Lagrange dualization and convex envelopes computed by dynamic programming; with robust training, more graphs are certified robust.

papers.title: Certifying Confidence via Randomized Smoothing
papers.summary: Certifies the prediction confidence of smoothed classifiers, as average score or margin, by modifying the Neyman-Pearson lemma to compute radii within which confidence stays above a threshold; using the confidence distribution gives notably larger certified radii on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet.

papers.title: Certifying Strategyproof Auction Networks
papers.summary: Verifies strategyproofness of RegretNet learned auction mechanisms under a given valuation profile with neural network verification techniques, modifying the architecture so it can be encoded exactly as an integer program, and produces certificates even where optimal mechanisms are unknown.

papers.title: Consistency Regularization for Certified Robustness of Smoothed Classifiers
papers.summary: Improves certified ℓ2 robustness of randomized-smoothing classifiers by regularizing prediction consistency over Gaussian noise during training, giving results better than or comparable to prior methods across architectures and datasets with less training cost and fewer hyperparameters.

papers.title: Counterexample-Guided Learning of Monotonic Neural Networks
papers.summary: COMET provably enforces monotonicity constraints on general ReLU networks at prediction time through counterexample-guided techniques, and uses monotonicity counterexamples as an inductive bias during training; on real-world datasets it outperforms existing monotonic learners.

papers.title: Denoised Smoothing: A Provable Defense for Pretrained Classifiers
papers.summary: Denoised smoothing makes any pretrained image classifier provably ℓp-robust by prepending a custom-trained denoiser and applying randomized smoothing, without modifying the classifier, in white-box and black-box settings; demonstrated on ImageNet, CIFAR-10 and the Azure, Google, AWS and ClarifAI APIs.

papers.title: Detection as Regression: Certified Object Detection with Median Smoothing
Efficient Exact Verification of Binarized Neural Networks
papers.summary: EEV performs exact verification of binarized neural networks with a SAT solver that natively handles reified cardinality constraints, plus training for solver-friendly BNNs; it gives exact ℓ∞ robustness results on convolutional BNNs for MNIST and CIFAR10, hundreds to thousands of times faster than real-valued verification.

papers.title: Enabling certification of verification-agnostic networks via memory-efficient semidefinite programming
papers.summary: A first-order dual SDP algorithm with memory linear in network activations, using iterative eigenvector methods via forward/backward passes on GPUs/TPUs, verifies networks not trained for verification; verified ℓ∞ accuracy rises from 1% to 88% on MNIST and 6% to 40% on CIFAR-10.

papers.title: Exactly Computing the Local Lipschitz Constant of ReLU Networks
papers.summary: Relates the local Lipschitz constant of nonsmooth functions to the generalized Jacobian, proves strong inapproximability for ReLU networks, and gives an algorithm computing the local Lipschitz constant exactly, used to assess the tightness of other Lipschitz estimators and the effects of regularized training.

papers.title: Higher-Order Certification For Randomized Smoothing
papers.summary: Extends randomized smoothing certification by framing radius computation as nested optimization and using first-order and higher-order information of Gaussian-smoothed classifiers, certifying larger safety regions with gains on ℓ1 radii and color-space ℓ2 radii on CIFAR10 and ImageNet.

papers.title: Learning Certified Individually Fair Representations
papers.summary: Learns representations certified for individual fairness: similar individuals are mapped within a certified ℓ∞ distance in latent space, so data consumers can certify fairness by proving ε-robustness of their classifier; evaluated on five real-world datasets with several fairness constraints.

papers.title: Lipschitz Bounds and Provably Robust Training by Laplacian Smoothing
papers.summary: Trains models with provable adversarial robustness by framing learning as Lipschitz-constrained loss minimization whose Lagrangian saddle point solves a weighted Laplacian Poisson equation, solved by graph discretization and primal-dual updates; also shows a fundamental robustness-accuracy lower bound.

papers.title: Lipschitz-Certifiable Training with a Tight Outer Bound
papers.summary: Speeds up certifiable training with box constraint propagation (BCP), combining Lipschitz analysis and interval arithmetic for a tighter outer bound; it trains over 12 times faster than a dual relaxation method with comparable verification and reaches 20.1% verified accuracy on Tiny ImageNet (ℓ2, 36/255).

papers.title: Neurosymbolic Reinforcement Learning with Formally Verified Exploration
papers.summary: Revel enables provably safe exploration in reinforcement learning by mirror descent between a neurosymbolic policy class and a verifiable symbolic class, avoiding repeated verification of neural networks; it enforces safe exploration where Constrained Policy Optimization fails and finds better policies.

papers.title: On the Tightness of Semidefinite Relaxations for Certifying Robustness to Adversarial Examples
papers.summary: Gives a geometric test of when the SDP relaxation certificate for ReLU network robustness is exact, viewing it as projecting a point onto a hyperbola; the certificate is proven exact for one hidden layer under mild assumptions and explained as usually conservative for several layers.

papers.title: Semialgebraic Optimization for Lipschitz Constants of ReLU Networks
papers.summary: Estimates global and local Lipschitz constants of multi-layer ReLU networks with a semidefinite programming hierarchy combining polynomial lifting of ReLU derivatives with a weak Putinar positivity certificate, sometimes giving better bounds in less time than linear programming approaches.

papers.title: The Convex Relaxation Barrier, Revisited: Tightened Single-Neuron Relaxations for Neural Network Verification
papers.summary: Derives the tightest convex relaxation of a ReLU over a box-bounded multivariate pre-activation input, separable in linear time, and builds LP-based and fast propagation verifiers on it that verify significantly more instances for a modest extra cost.

months.label: July 2020
months.intro: ASE 2020 and OOPSLA 2020 decisions: global and relational properties take centre stage, with NeuroDiff's differential verification of similar ReLU networks, such as original and compressed models, and Libra's perfectly parallel static analysis for certifying fairness of feed-forward neural networks.

papers.title: NEURODIFF: Scalable Differential Verification of Neural Networks using Fine-Grained Approximation
papers.summary: NeuroDiff verifies equivalence of two similar feed-forward ReLU networks, such as an original and compressed model, using new convex approximations of their difference plus selective symbolic variables; it is up to 1000x faster and 5x more accurate than the prior tool.

papers.title: Perfectly parallel fairness certification of neural networks
papers.summary: Libra certifies fairness of feed-forward neural networks for tabular classification with a perfectly parallel, sound static analysis; when certification fails it describes and quantifies biased input regions, with configurable scalability and precision for pay-as-you-go certification.

months.label: June 2020
months.intro: ICML 2020 and IROS 2020 decisions: randomized smoothing theory leads, covering label-flipping certificates, curse-of-dimensionality limits, sparsity-aware certificates for graphs and optimal smoothing distributions. LayerCert offers hierarchical exact verification, curvature bounds give second-order certificates, and verification reaches neural network control policies and robot state estimation, plus robust training against programmable string transformations.

papers.title: Black-box Certification and Learning under Adversarial Perturbations
papers.summary: Studies learning and third-party black-box certification of classifiers under adversarial perturbations in a PAC-type semi-supervised framework, giving possibility and impossibility results for VC-classes and analysing certification with a limited query budget.

papers.title: Certified Robustness to Label-Flipping Attacks via Randomized Smoothing
papers.summary: Uses randomized smoothing over arbitrary functions to certify classifiers against data poisoning, instantiated as linear classifiers certified against label flipping per test point with a deterministic analytical bound, little extra runtime, and the first multi-class label-flipping certificate.

papers.title: Curse of Dimensionality on Randomized Smoothing for Certifiable Robustness
papers.summary: Proves that for many i.i.d. smoothing distributions the largest certifiable ℓp radius shrinks with input dimension for p > 2, so Gaussian smoothing is optimal up to a constant factor; uniform ℓ1 and ℓ∞ smoothing scale even worse, with CIFAR experiments.

papers.title: Efficient Robustness Certificates for Discrete Data: Sparsity-Aware Randomized Smoothing for Graphs, Images and More
papers.summary: A sparsity-aware randomized smoothing certificate for discrete data that is model-agnostic, tight and efficient, with cost independent of input dimension or category count; it certifies any Graph Neural Network against perturbations to graph structure and node attributes.

papers.title: Hierarchical Verification for Adversarial Robustness
papers.summary: LayerCert performs exact ℓp robustness verification of ReLU networks by exploring activation regions hierarchically along the nested hyperplane arrangement induced by layers, provably solving fewer and smaller convex programs than GeoCert and reducing running time.

papers.title: Neural Network Control Policy Verification With Persistent Adversarial Perturbation
Randomized Smoothing of All Shapes and Sizes
papers.summary: A general theory for randomized smoothing finds optimal smoothing distributions via the Wulff Crystal and two methods for robust radii of any distribution, improving certified ℓ1 accuracy; Banach space cotypes show limits on certifying ℓp perturbations in high dimensions.

papers.title: Robustness to Programmable String Transformations via Augmented Abstract Training
papers.summary: Trains NLP models robust to user-defined string transformations such as insertions, deletions, substitutions and swaps, specified in a programmable language, by splitting specifications into parts handled by search and by abstraction; evaluated on AG and SST2.

papers.title: Scalable Differential Privacy with Certified Robustness in Adversarial Learning
papers.summary: Preserves differential privacy in adversarial learning for deep neural networks while certifying robustness, by randomizing input and latent spaces, an adversarial objective based on DP post-processing, and stochastic batch training that scales to large networks and datasets.

papers.title: Second-Order Provable Defenses against Adversarial Attacks
papers.summary: Computes ℓ2 robustness certificates for networks with differentiable activations via convex optimization when Hessian eigenvalues are bounded, using a differentiable curvature bound also as a regularizer; CRT reaches 69.79%, 57.78% and 53.19% certified accuracy on MNIST versus about 45% for IBP.

papers.title: Practical Verification of Neural Network Enabled State Estimation System for Robotics
papers.summary: Verifies robustness of learning-enabled robot state estimation, where a neural network feeds a Bayes filter, by reducing it to labelled transition systems with payoffs and solving a constrained optimization; on a Kalman-filter WAMI vehicle tracking system it verifies robustness and finds counterexamples.

months.label: April 2020
months.intro: CAV 2020 and IJCAI 2020 decisions: complete verification and tooling lead, with abstraction-refinement integrated into Marabou, faster geometric path enumeration, the NNV tool with ImageStar verification of large CNNs, and GDVB benchmark generation. IJCAI adds individual fairness, metamorphic testing with certified fairness mitigation for NLP models, and verifiable RNN-based policies for POMDPs.

papers.title: An Abstraction-Based Framework for Neural Network Verification
papers.summary: Shrinks neural networks by over-approximation so properties proven on the smaller abstract network hold for the original, refining with counterexample guidance on spurious results; integrated with Marabou, it significantly improves verification performance on larger networks.

papers.title: Improved Geometric Path Enumeration for Verifying ReLU Neural Networks
papers.summary: Speeds up exact geometric path enumeration verification of ReLU networks through a series of optimizations, several algorithmically new, running sometimes hundreds of times faster on ACAS Xu and often fastest on harder instances, even beating over-approximating methods.

papers.title: NNV: The Neural Network Verification Tool for Deep Neural Networks and Learning-Enabled Cyber-Physical Systems
papers.summary: NNV is a set-based verification tool for deep neural networks and learning-enabled cyber-physical systems, using polyhedra, star sets, zonotopes and abstract domains for exact and over-approximate reachability, with closed-loop analysis via CORA; case studies cover ACAS Xu and adaptive cruise control.

papers.title: Systematic Generation of Diverse Benchmarks for DNN Verification
papers.summary: GDVB generates diverse neural network verification benchmarks by systematically varying problem factors that affect verifier performance, offering richer and less biased sets of verification problems for comparing verifiers.

papers.title: Verification of Deep Convolutional Neural Networks Using ImageStars
papers.summary: Verifies robustness of large CNNs such as VGG16 and VGG19 on ImageNet with the ImageStar set representation, combining concrete image operations with linear programming for exact and over-approximate analysis in NNV; it is less conservative and faster than zonotope and polytope methods.

papers.title: Individual Fairness Revisited: Transferring Techniques from Adversarial Robustness
Metamorphic Testing and Certified Mitigation of Fairness Violations in NLP Models
papers.summary: Tests NLP models for fairness violations with metamorphic testing, then defines (ε, k)-fairness and smooths predictions to give certified fairness guarantees. Flags thousands of discriminatory inputs in popular commercial NLP models and adds certification at modest cost.

papers.title: Verifiable RNN-Based Policies for POMDPs Under Temporal Logic Constraints

months.label: February 2020
months.intro: CVPR 2020 decisions: verification moves beyond ℓp inputs, with robustness guarantees for CNN-RNN video classifiers under optical flow perturbations and Semantify-NN, which verifies robustness to hue, brightness, contrast and rotation through semantic perturbation layers.

papers.title: Robustness Guarantees for Deep Neural Networks on Videos
papers.summary: Bounds the maximum safe radius of CNN-RNN video classifiers over optical flow perturbations, using Lipschitz-based discretisation and a cooperative two-player game solved anytime, with gradient search for upper bounds and admissible A* for lower bounds; evaluated on UCF101.

papers.title: Towards Verifying Robustness of Neural Networks Against A Family of Semantic Perturbations
papers.summary: Semantify-NN verifies robustness to semantic perturbations such as hue, saturation, brightness, contrast and rotation by prepending semantic perturbation layers, so any ℓp-norm verifier applies; a refinement step tightens certificates beyond naive ℓp conversion across architectures and datasets.

months.label: December 2019
months.intro: ICLR 2020 and ICSE 2020 decisions: certified training is prominent, with COLT, CROWN-IBP, MACER and certified patch defenses, while randomized smoothing gains f-divergence and top-k certificates. Other directions include robustness verification for Transformers, learned branching for branch-and-bound, SAT-friendly binarized neural networks, LiPopt Lipschitz estimation and ReluDiff's differential verification.

papers.title: ReluDiff: differential verification of deep neural networks
papers.summary: ReluDiff performs differential verification of two closely related networks, such as an original and its compressed version, using a forward interval pass that exploits their similarity and gradient-guided backward refinement, giving orders-of-magnitude speedups and more proved properties.

papers.title: A Framework for robustness Certification of Smoothed Classifiers using F-Divergences
papers.summary: Generalises randomized smoothing to arbitrary smoothing measures and perturbation classes, certifying robustness of black-box smoothed classifiers via f-divergences; reports state-of-the-art certified robustness on MNIST, CIFAR-10, ImageNet and Librispeech audio classification.

papers.title: Adversarial Training and Provable Defenses: Bridging the Gap
papers.summary: COLT, convex layerwise adversarial training, trains certifiably robust networks by having an adversary search inside the verifier's convex relaxation at each layer. Reaches 60.5% certified robustness and 78.4% accuracy on CIFAR-10 at 2/255 L∞, beating concurrent results.

papers.title: Certified Defenses for Adversarial Patches
papers.summary: Shows existing preprocessing defenses against adversarial patches break under simple white-box attacks, then gives the first certified defense against patch attacks with faster training methods, reporting good robustness transfer across patch shapes and preliminary results for sparse attacks.

papers.title: Certified Robustness for Top-k Predictions against Adversarial Perturbations via Randomized Smoothing
papers.summary: Extends randomized smoothing certificates from top-1 to top-k predictions, deriving a tight ℓ2 robustness radius under Gaussian noise. On ImageNet it reaches 62.8% certified top-5 accuracy for perturbations with ℓ2 norm below 0.5; also evaluated on CIFAR10.

papers.title: In Search for a SAT-friendly Binarized Neural Network Architecture
papers.summary: Studies how binarized neural network architecture and training choices affect SAT-based reasoning, and proposes changes that yield SAT-friendly BNNs without accuracy loss, scaling existential and probabilistic queries to larger networks with significant speedups on all tested datasets.

papers.title: Lipschitz constant estimation of Neural Networks via sparse polynomial optimization
papers.summary: LiPopt computes increasingly tight upper bounds on neural network Lipschitz constants via polynomial optimization reduced to LP or SDP, exploiting sparse connectivity for convolutional and pruned networks; gives better ℓ∞-Lipschitz estimates than baselines on random and MNIST networks.

papers.title: MACER: Attack-free and Scalable Robust Training via Maximizing Certified Radius
papers.summary: MACER trains provably robust smoothed classifiers by directly maximizing the certified ℓ2 radius from randomized smoothing, without adversarial attacks. On CIFAR-10, ImageNet, MNIST and SVHN it trains faster than adversarial training and achieves larger average certified radius.

papers.title: Neural Network Branching for Neural Network Verification
papers.summary: Learns a branching strategy for branch-and-bound neural network verification with a graph neural network that imitates strong branching on the verified network's graph, roughly halving branches and verification time on convolutional networks and transferring to harder properties and larger networks.

papers.title: Provable robustness against all adversarial $l_p$-perturbations for $p\geq 1$
Robustness Verification for Transformers
papers.summary: The first robustness verification algorithm for Transformers, handling the cross-nonlinearity and cross-position dependency of self-attention layers. Its certified bounds are much tighter than naive Interval Bound Propagation and reflect word importance in sentiment analysis.

papers.title: Towards Stable and Efficient Training of Verifiably Robust Neural Networks
papers.summary: CROWN-IBP trains verifiably robust networks by combining fast IBP bounds in a forward pass with tight CROWN linear-relaxation bounds in a backward pass, reaching 7.02% verified error on MNIST at ε=0.3 and 66.94% on CIFAR-10 at ε=8/255.

papers.title: Towards Verified Robustness under Text Deletion Interventions
papers.summary: Formally verifies that decomposable-attention natural language inference models do not grow more confident when arbitrary word subsets are deleted, using interval bound propagation. IBP training raises verified samples on SNLI from 2.8% to 18.4%.

papers.title: Towards neural networks that provably know when they don't know
Universal Approximation with Certified Networks
papers.summary: Proves a universal approximation theorem for interval-certified ReLU networks: any continuous function can be approximated by a network whose interval bound propagation over a region is arbitrarily close to the function's optimal output range there.

months.label: November 2019
months.intro: AAAI 2020 and USENIX Security 2020 decisions: Venus prunes MILP search through ReLU dependency analysis, Fastened CROWN tightens certificates, and randomized smoothing and ablation address sparse attacks. Certification also extends to weight perturbations, with robustness-aware quantization, and to verifiably robust PDF malware classifiers.

papers.title: On Training Robust PDF Malware Classifiers
papers.summary: Trains PDF malware classifiers with formally verified robustness properties over subtree insertions and deletions using verifiably robust training, achieving 92.27% average verified robust accuracy with 99.74% accuracy and 0.56% false positives, and raising evasion cost for unrestricted attackers.

papers.title: Efficient Verification of ReLU-Based Neural Networks via Dependency Analysis
papers.summary: Venus verifies ReLU feed-forward networks by exploiting dependency relations between ReLU nodes to prune the MILP search tree, combined with input domain splitting and symbolic interval propagation; evaluated on ACAS collision-avoidance, MNIST and CIFAR-10 models with considerable gains.

papers.title: Fastened CROWN: Tightened Neural Network Robustness Certificates
Regularized Training and Tight Certification for Randomized Smoothed Classifier with Provable Robustness
Robustness Certificates for Sparse Adversarial Attacks by Randomized Ablation
Towards Certificated Model Robustness Against Weight Perturbations
